headline: ‘It’s a Wonderful Life’ Plans a Broadway Debut With Andrew Rannells
context: The show, “a live radio play,” will run during this year’s holiday season. The cast includes Andrew Rannells, Megan Hilty, Tituss Burgess, Harry Hamlin and Lisa Rinna.
